name: Speech Bubble
scaffolding_intent: Displays a pixelated speech bubble above a character who is speaking in the scene, prompting the child to report speech with a linguistic verb

parameters.name: bubbleText
parameters.description: '...' (default) or a single word quoted verbatim from the child's utterance. Never invented dialogue.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Size multiplier for the speech bubble

correction_intent: Child attributed speech to the wrong character, or denied speech to a character the scene shows speaking (open mouth, shouting, on the phone). Target the character actually speaking.
suggestion_intent: A character is visibly speaking in the scene and the child has not reported it with a linguistic verb (said, asked, told, shouted). Target that character. Requires visible evidence of speech.
